verse: If you instruct the brethren in these things, you will be a good minister of Jesus Christ.—1 Timothy 4:6.
title: The Church's Loving Discipline and Merciful Restoration
bullets: The church's role is to lovingly warn and instruct those who fall into sin, speaking God's truth about wrongdoing with long-suffering and compassion.
When a sinner repents, the church must receive them with grateful hearts and lead them into the light of faith, just as Jesus would.
The church's authority to bind and loose sin is ratified in heaven—our faithful correction of sin and merciful restoration of the repentant mirrors God's own heart.
prayer: Lord, help me to see my church family through Your eyes of both truth and mercy. Give me wisdom to lovingly address sin when needed and a heart overflowing with grace to welcome back the repentant, so that Your kingdom might be reflected in all we do together.
